text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: P99 latency SLO breach detected for hosted cluster shared-nvme-1 in us-west-2. p95=420ms, p99=2.8s over last 3m, increased streaming stalls observed. Auto-paging alice_oncall.

alice_oncall: paging in. seeing elevated tail on streaming routes (/v1/chat/stream). Can someone grab kernel/io stats and active tenants?

bob_sre: on it. pulling iostat and blkio counters now. preliminary: nvme avg await from nvme0n1 ~ 12ms -> 190ms on burst, queue_depth spikes. blkio.throttle.io_service_bytes_recursive shows heavy write throughput from cgroup:/tenants/tenant-87.

carla_runtime: confirming: realtime metrics show one tenant (tenant-87) doing large checkpoint writes during model warmup; sustained 6GB/s write bursts to local NVMe. Streaming requests are hitting queued IO for kv-cache writes.

alice_oncall: customer impact? dan_cs can you estimate affected customers?

dan_cs: quick check on request logs: ~4200 streaming requests in last 5 min that saw >500ms token latencies. Top affected customers: AcmeApps (approx 18k requests/min but only 3% affected), Shoply (12% of streaming requests error/timeout), internal e2e tests also failing. No 5xx surge, mostly 504 timeouts on the streaming proxy after 15s.

eric_prod: p95 baseline for this pool is ~120ms; this is a clear noisy-neighbor IO saturation. can we throttle or move the tenant?

bob_sre: recommended immediate mitigations: 1) set blkio weight for tenant-87 to 10 (low priority) 2) temporarily pin tenant-87 to a dedicated draining node 3) reduce concurrency (max inflight) for streaming on shared-nvme-1 to 50% to ease tail. I'm applying 1 now.

carla_runtime: +1 to throttling. also enable prefix KV caching to reduce writes for streaming if possible. applying routing policy rule to route all new requests from enterprise-tier -> fallback-model redwood-small-q4 in same region for 10m as soft mitigation.

alice_oncall: bob, confirm when blkio weight applied. also paste the commands you run for the runbook.

bob_sre: applied weight. commands run: ```
# set blkio weight via systemd slice/cgroup
cgset -r blkio.weight=10 /tenants/tenant-87
# or via cgroup v2
echo 10 > /sys/fs/cgroup/tenants.slice/tenant-87/blkio.weight
```
Now watching iostat. write latency dropped from 190ms -> 45ms after ~15s.

carla_runtime: routing rule deployed: ```
PATCH /routing/policies/active
{ "match": "tenant-tier:enterprise AND region:us-west-2", "action": "route->redwood-small-q4", "ttl": 600 }
```
applied at 2277770032.

alice_oncall: monitoring p95/p99. metrics: at 2277770040 p95=260ms p99=1.1s. still elevated but trending down. streaming stalls count cut by ~60%.

dan_cs: customer-facing note: drafting short incident note to impacted Shoply account, clarifying we saw transient IO saturation caused by background checkpoint activity and that we migrated/made QoS changes. Will wait for final confirmation before sending.

florence_ops: I'm spinning a spare node into the shared pool for extra IO headroom (adding nvme-backed node). ETA ~= 4m. scaling action id: scale-attach-1137.

eric_prod: also enabling automatic fallback for streaming proxy to non-streaming chunked responses when stall detected to avoid client 504s. config change: set streaming.token_timeout_ms=8000 -> 12000 during mitigation window.

bob_sre: note: found long-running background job on tenant-87 triggering huge checkpoint dumps every 30s. reaching out to tenant owner for schedule change. We'll schedule a follow-up to ensure off-peak checkpointing or use object storage for checkpoints instead of local NVMe.

alice_oncall: handoff note for next oncall: event mitigated but follow-up required. Summary to include: cause=noisy tenant checkpoint writes; mitigations applied=blkio.weight=10, routing fallback->redwood-small-q4, reduced streaming concurrency to 50%, added node; customer impact=Shoply ~12% streaming timeouts, AcmeApps small fraction; current status=latencies back within SLOs p95=140ms p99=320ms as of 2277770108.

carla_runtime: confirm final metrics at 2277770110: p95=138ms p99=310ms, streaming-stalls ~2% of baseline.

alice_oncall: handing off to bob_sre for postmortem and remediation. bob, please own follow-up (tiering rules for checkpoint IO, enforce cgroup IO scheduling, tenant guidelines). I'll update incident channel and trigger postmortem doc.

bob_sre: taking handoff. next steps: 1) root-cause analysis (collect blkio, nvme SMART, kernel logs) 2) internal runbook update to auto-detect checkpoint spikes and throttle background IO 3) contact tenant owner and propose schedule change + recommend S3-backed checkpoints 4) consider adding IO qdisc or hardware QoS at host level if repeats.

dan_cs: sending customer note now (will cc ops & prod).

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied; severity reduced. created follow-up task: ENG-IO-2277.

alice_oncall: closing paging loop. if anything spikes again ping with `@alice_oncall` and set priority. Good job team :thumbsup:
